fact: Maroc Telecom's half-year 2026 report (published 23 July 2026) states Moov Money Tchad SA obtained its payment institution licence in the first half of 2026 under the COBAC payment services regulation, after Airtel Money (March 2022) and Konoom (October 2025).
title: Tchad : Moov Money décroche son agrément d'établissement de paiement
